Subject: After-demo follow-up: propose slot swap + cross-region handoff plan

Hi Emma / Peter —

Thanks again for jumping on the demo earlier today. We heard your use case loud and clear (high-query fanout, mixed PII and PHI surface, and strong latency expectations for regional apps). As promised, I want to lock in the next steps: a technical deep-dive with Olga (EU AE) focused on model routing and a short follow-up with Vivek (APAC deployments) to validate region-specific latency expectations.

Reality: your preferred windows are morning CET and afternoon PT — which makes a same-day sequential follow-up tricky across APAC. To avoid awkward gaps, I propose swapping the originally-proposed Tuesday slot to one that aligns availability across all regions for a clean SDR->AE->APAC handoff.

Proposal (all times listed with timezone labels):
- Option A: Tue Oct 13, 09:00–09:45 CET (08:00–08:45 BST) — Olga does the AE deep-dive, Vivek joins for the last 15 min to agree on latency requirements.
- Option B: Tue Oct 13, 16:00–16:45 PT (23:00–23:45 CET) — US-first slot; will require Vivek to join late night, but gives your team a US-centric timeline.
- Option C: Wed Oct 14, 07:00–07:45 AEST (Tue Oct 13, 18:00–18:45 PT) — APAC-friendly; Olga will record the session for your CET team and we’ll have a 30-min follow-up the next morning CET.

Quick note on DST: EU moves off DST earlier than US this month; I added explicit timezone labels rather than relying on relative descriptors to avoid confusion when we create the calendar invites.

I attached an updated Mutual Action Plan (v2) and a small calendar snapshot of the candidate windows in UTC. Can you confirm which option works best or suggest two alternate times?

Thanks —
Marcus
SDR, Redwood Inference
